children: ) (“SVC” or the “Company”) today announced that Flat Footed LLC (“Flat Footed”), an SVC institutional shareholder, has expressed support for the plan announced earlier today by SVC’s Board of Trustees to transition SVC into a pure-play triple net lease REIT.
Marc Andersen, Co-Founder and Managing Member of Flat Footed LLC, made the following statement:

“Given the capital recently deployed into the retained hotel portfolio and the commitment of SVC’s Board to convert the Company into a triple net lease REIT over the next two years, Flat Footed supports SVC’s decision to monetize the hotel portfolio at a pace that allows for maximum value realization. Our firm also believes that many RMR-related entities remain misunderstood and materially undervalued. RMR client REITs have sold $3.6 billion in assets since the beginning of 2021, and SVC alone has sold in excess of $1.9 billion. In large part due to viewing this capital allocation favorably, Flat Footed remains, or has become, a meaningful shareholder in multiple entities across the RMR complex.”

As previously outlined in the Board’s letter, SVC plans to begin selling its 77 retained hotels in 2027 with the goal of selling substantially all of them by the end of 2028. These sales are intended to maximize value for shareholders as EBITDA at the retained hotels grows, while reducing SVC’s leverage to no more than five times net debt to Adjusted EBITDA as SVC completes its transition to a pure-play triple net lease REIT.

SVC is a real estate investment trust with $9.6 billion invested in two asset categories: service-focused retail net lease properties and hotels. As of September 30, 2026, SVC owned 740 service-focused retail net lease properties with over 13.5 million square feet throughout the United States and 87 hotels with approximately 20,000 guest rooms throughout the United States, including Puerto Rico, and Canada. SVC is managed by The RMR Group (

), a leading U.S. alternative asset management company with approximately $37 billion in assets under management as of September 30, 2026, and 40 years of institutional experience in buying, selling, financing and operating commercial real estate. SVC is headquartered in Newton, MA. For more information, visit www.svcreit.com.
